user_intent_summary: Design a small, desktop-sized storage box with a hinged lid that stays closed until manually released by the user's thumb, using additive manufacturing for production.
product_intent: A small storage box with a hinged lid that remains closed until intentionally opened by user action, designed for safe use, easy assembly, and practical manufacturing via additive methods.

clauses.text: Design a small storage box with a hinged lid
The lid should stay closed until the user releases it with a thumb
The box should be safe to use

requirements.statement: The storage box must have a hinged lid that remains closed until intentionally released by user thumb action

verification.observable: Lid remains closed until user applies thumb force to release it
verification.condition: User applies thumb pressure to lid

requirements.statement: The storage box must be safe for user operation

verification.observable: No sharp edges, no hazardous materials, no mechanical parts that could cause injury
verification.condition: Product inspection under normal use conditions

requirements.statement: The storage box must be easy to assemble by user

verification.observable: Assembly process completed within reasonable time with no special tools required
verification.condition: User attempts assembly without specialized equipment

requirements.statement: The storage box must be practical to manufacture using additive manufacturing methods

verification.observable: Product design compatible with additive manufacturing processes, no overhangs requiring supports
verification.condition: Design review for additive manufacturing capabilities

requirements.statement: The storage box must be desktop-sized

verification.observable: Physical dimensions of product fit within desktop workspace
verification.condition: Product measured against typical desktop workspace requirements

requirements.statement: The storage box must operate manually without external power sources or mechanisms

verification.observable: Storage box operates solely through manual user actions
verification.condition: User attempts operation without external power source

freedoms.subject: Specific type of hinge mechanism
freedoms.statement: The user does not specify the exact hinge design, only that it must stay closed until released by thumb

freedoms.subject: Specific release mechanism
freedoms.statement: The user does not specify exact thumb release method, only that it requires thumb action

freedoms.subject: Specific manufacturing process within additive methods
freedoms.statement: The user specifies additive manufacturing is expected but does not require a specific additive method

relations.rationale: The manual operation requirement must be satisfied to enable the thumb release mechanism
Manufacturability constraints refine the functional requirements for the hinged lid design

operating_scenarios.name: Normal Use Scenario
operating_scenarios.description: User places items in storage box, closes lid manually, and opens with thumb release

operating_scenarios.name: Assembly Scenario
operating_scenarios.description: User assembles the storage box following manufacturer's instructions without special tools

operating_scenarios.name: Manufacturing Scenario
operating_scenarios.description: Storage box is produced using additive manufacturing methods in accordance with design specifications

assumptions.statement: The user expects the storage box to be small enough for desktop use but not specified in exact dimensions
The storage box will be designed to accommodate typical desktop workspace requirements

unknowns.subject: Exact physical dimensions of the storage box
unknowns.reason: The request only states that it should be desktop-sized but does not specify exact measurements

unknowns.subject: Specific type of additive manufacturing method to be used
unknowns.reason: The request only states that additive manufacturing is expected but does not specify which specific technology
unknowns.resolvable_by: User specifies the preferred additive manufacturing process

discovery_outcomes.reason: All clauses from request and clarifications were identified and classified
Both user intent summary and product intent were formulated as requested
Functional, safety, manufacturing, and performance requirements derived from clauses
Three freedoms identified regarding unspecified design aspects
Three operating scenarios derived from the functional requirements and context
Two assumptions identified about unspecified details in the request
Two unknowns identified regarding exact dimensions and specific manufacturing method
